provenance: User-provided Cassandra row and pumphouse JSON; this file is a mapping proposal, not the complete raw snapshot or full plant dictionary.

station.name_status: Provisional US-style label for the requested treated-wastewater context, not a verified facility name or duty.
station.source_identity_status: User confirmed entity_uuid identifies the pumphouse; parent_entity_uuid is shared across all pumphouses in this feed. This does not establish a physical parent asset or Client assignment.

pump_identity.scope: Proposed stable pump slots within this station; display-name changes do not regenerate UUIDs. Source-key aliases must be registered explicitly.

source_row.data2_status: Shown as null in the supplied export; column type and semantics unconfirmed.

source_layout.confirmation: User explanation of the supplied feed; logical meanings confirmed, Cassandra partition/clustering declaration still pending.
source_layout.timestamp_policy: Preserve exact sample milliseconds; do not round, synthesize missing samples, or assume all five-second samples are present.

sample_time.interpretation_status: User confirmed sub_time_period is the sample timestamp in epoch milliseconds and time_period its hour bucket. User later confirmed egt is the Event Generation Timestamp and ext the Expiration Timestamp (egt + default real-time expiry period; 300 s in this sample). dex.TIMESTAMP matches egt arithmetically. The expiry period value is a source default, not an application TTL or freshness policy.

basic_params.scope: Station-level 'basic params' of the pumphouse envelope in data1. Presence and level are now confirmed against a second real snapshot (sub_time_period 1752853013703) in which every listed key appears. Meanings of the code sets (st, dsc) and the engineering units are still unconfirmed.

fields.name: Event Generation Timestamp
fields.notes: Equals sub_time_period in both observed snapshots.

fields.name: Surge Pool Level
fields.notes: Observed 132.0436248779297, equal to /dex/COMMAN_FORBAY_LEVEL in the same snapshot; equivalence is still not an approved alias.

fields.name: Total Discharge Value
fields.notes: Confirmed present at /dv and at /pd/P{n}/dv. Observed 0.0 everywhere while all pumps are idle, so the value tells us nothing about units or aggregation window yet.

fields.name: Input Power (MW)
fields.notes: Confirmed at /pmw and /pd/P{n}/pmw. Observed 0.0 with all pumps idle.

fields.name: Input Power (MVar)
fields.notes: Confirmed at /pmvar and /pd/P{n}/pmvar. Observed 0.0 with all pumps idle.

fields.name: Number of Pumps Running
fields.notes: Station level only; absent from /pd/P{n}. Transported as a float (observed 0.0), not an integer, so a reader must not assume int. Should agree with the count of /pd/P{n}/st == 'R'.

fields.name: Pumphouse Running Status
fields.notes: Observed 'I' at station level and at every /pd/P{n}/st. Confirmed vocabulary: I = Idle, R = Running. The same key carries pump running status, so the listed station name understates where it appears.

fields.name: Pump Operation Details
fields.notes: Pump-level map keyed by registered source_key (P1..P14); each entry carries st, dv, pmw, pmvar.

fields.name: Data Source
fields.notes: Observed 24, stated as 'SCADA Device'; enum table unconfirmed.

fields.name: Expiration Timestamp
fields.notes: egt + default real-time expiry period. 300000 ms in both observed snapshots.

expiry.policy: Source expiry; do not use as an application retention TTL or to discard historical rows.

payload_paths.dex_observed_tag_count: ~700 in a full snapshot; the 17-tag pilot excerpt is a small subset

mapping_policy.raw_tag_preservation: Exact case, whitespace, spelling, repeated prefixes and JSON path are retained separately from catalogue matching.
mapping_policy.binding_identity: Registered source namespace plus station UUID plus exact payload path; never the friendly label or a tag shared by multiple houses.
mapping_policy.shared_value_policy: Keep top-level and pd values distinct from dex readings. Matching sample values do not prove aliases.
mapping_policy.value_policy: Preserve raw strings and signed values; parse numbers without discarding originals. Do not infer GOOD quality, clamp values, or derive alarm thresholds from this snapshot.
